newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA Cardon reformer running at minimum level.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA Cardon reformer running at minimum level.

text.p: The 45,000 barrel per day (bpd) reformer at Venezuela's Cardon refinery was still running at minimum throughput on Monday after a problem emerged Friday in the catalyst regenerator, a source familiar with the refinery's operations said Monday.

The reformer has been operating below capacity since a fire hit a related hydro-desulphurisation unit on July 28, and was a major factor in Petroleos de Venezuela's (PDVSA) decision to declare force majeure on nine gasoline cargoes in August.
"The reformer is working at its minimum level. The catalytic regenrator is the unit having problems now," the source said.
He said last week that the September export program could be affected by the prolonged problems.
Six 230,000-barrel cargoes of reformulated and anti-dumping gasoline are due to be exported from Cardon in September.
In August, two and a half cargoes of gasoline were cancelled while other customers accepted alternative supplies.
